title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Human Reason and Reflection
text:
Human Reason and Reflection

Key terms: Human Reason, Reflection

Humans possess reason and the ability to reflect on their actions, allowing them to use language and communicate with each other. This unique capacity enables them to express their thoughts and desires, share ideas, and discuss what they consider good and desirable. Political theory has its roots in the twin aspects of the human self.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Human Reason and Reflection in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Politics and Self-Interest
text:
Politics and Self-Interest

Key terms: Politics, Self-Interest

Politics is often associated with the pursuit of self-interest by any means possible. However, this is not the only aspect of politics. Politics is an important and integral part of any society, and it involves the multiple negotiations that go on in society through which collective decisions are made.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Politics and Self-Interest in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Freedom and Equality
text:
Freedom and Equality

Key terms: Freedom, Equality

Freedom and equality are fundamental values that have inspired people and guided policies throughout history. They are enshrined in constitutions and are continually being reinterpreted in response to new circumstances. Freedom and equality are not absolute and can be limited by other values and principles.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Freedom and Equality in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Political Theory and Practice
text:
Political Theory and Practice

Key terms: Political Theory, Practice

Political theory deals with the ideas and principles that shape constitutions, governments, and social life. It clarifies the meaning of concepts such as freedom, equality, justice, democracy, and secularism. Political theory has a lot to teach us about possible answers to questions about freedom, equality, and justice.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Political Theory and Practice in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Justice and Morality
text:
Justice and Morality

Key terms: Justice, Morality

Justice and morality are complex concepts that have been debated by philosophers throughout history. Socrates, in his book 'The Republic', examined the question of what is justice through a dialogue between himself and Cephalus. The concept of justice is multifaceted and can be understood in different ways.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Justice and Morality in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Regulation and Freedom
text:
Regulation and Freedom

Key terms: Regulation, Freedom

The rise of global communications technology has raised questions about the balance between regulation and freedom. Governments and private regulators must decide how much regulation is justified and who should regulate. Political theory has a lot to teach us about possible answers to these questions.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Regulation and Freedom in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Human Rights and Interpretation
text:
Human Rights and Interpretation

Key terms: Human Rights, Interpretation

Human rights are fundamental rights that are guaranteed by constitutions. However, these rights are continually being reinterpreted in response to new circumstances. The right to life has been interpreted to include the right to livelihood, and the right to information has been granted through a new law.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Human Rights and Interpretation in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Socrates and the Republic
text:
Socrates and the Republic

Key terms: Socrates, The Republic

Socrates was a philosopher who questioned and challenged popularly held beliefs about society, religion, and politics. His student Plato wrote extensively about his life and ideas, including his book 'The Republic', which examined the question of what is justice.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Socrates and the Republic in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Socrates' Method
text:
Socrates' Method

Key terms: Socratic method, critical thinking

Socrates used reason to reveal the limitations and inconsistencies in a given point of view, making his adversaries admit that their views could not be sustained. He asked questions to encourage critical thinking and to expose the flaws in his opponents' arguments. This method is still used today in various forms of critical thinking and debate.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Socrates' Method in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Equality
text:
Equality

Key terms: equality, fairness

Equality means equal opportunity for all, but it also involves fairness and justice. It requires that some agency be made responsible to ensure fairness, especially for the poor and disadvantaged. Equality is a complex concept that depends on the context.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Equality in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Justice
text:
Justice

Key terms: justice, virtue

Justice is the proper virtue of man, and it involves doing good to friends when they are good and harming enemies when they are evil. The just man is not a thief, and he does not harm anyone. Justice is a complex concept that requires careful consideration of different perspectives.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Justice in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Political Theory
text:
Political Theory

Key terms: political theory, public policy

Political theory is the study of political concepts and ideas. It involves examining the meanings of concepts like equality and freedom, and debating and examining the diverse meanings and opinions in a systematic manner. Political theory is relevant for all citizens, and it provides guidelines for framing public policies.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Political Theory in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Citizenship
text:
Citizenship

Key terms: citizenship, democracy

Citizenship involves being responsible and informed, and participating in the democratic process. Citizens have the power to set the agenda and appreciate the output, and they can influence the decisions made by those who play politics. Citizenship is a crucial aspect of democracy.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Citizenship in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Freedom
text:
Freedom

Key terms: freedom, dignity

Freedom involves the ability to make choices and act on them. It requires that individuals be treated with dignity and respect, and that they have the opportunity to pursue their goals and aspirations. Freedom is a complex concept that depends on the context.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Freedom in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Secularism
text:
Secularism

Key terms: secularism, democracy

Secularism involves the separation of religion and state. It requires that individuals be free to practice their religion, but also that the state not favor one religion over another. Secularism is a crucial aspect of democracy.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Secularism in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Freedom as Absence of Constraints
text:
Freedom as Absence of Constraints

Key terms: constraints, autonomy, independent decisions

Freedom is the absence of external constraints that prevent individuals from making independent decisions and acting autonomously.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Freedom as Absence of Constraints in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Freedom as Personal Development
text:
Freedom as Personal Development

Key terms: personal development, expression, potential

Freedom also involves creating conditions that allow individuals to express themselves and develop their potential and creativity.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Freedom as Personal Development in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Necessary Constraints
text:
Necessary Constraints

Key terms: necessary constraints, order, democratic governance

Some constraints are necessary to maintain order and protect individual freedom, such as laws and democratic governance.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Necessary Constraints in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Harm Principle
text:
Harm Principle

Key terms: harm principle, John Stuart Mill, prevent harm

John Stuart Mill's harm principle suggests that the only purpose for which power can be rightfully exercised over any member of a civilized community, against their will, is to prevent harm to others.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Harm Principle in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Freedom Struggles
text:
Freedom Struggles

Key terms: freedom struggles, sacrifice, Nelson Mandela, Aung San Suu Kyi

People throughout history have fought for freedom, often sacrificing personal comforts and even their lives, as seen in the struggles of Nelson Mandela and Aung San Suu Kyi.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Freedom Struggles in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Freedom vs. Fear
text:
Freedom vs. Fear

Key terms: freedom from fear, dignified life, opinions of others

Aung San Suu Kyi's concept of freedom is 'freedom from fear', which allows individuals to live a dignified life without being afraid of the opinions of others or authority.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Freedom vs. Fear in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Swaraj
text:
Swaraj

Key terms: Swaraj, self-rule, self-realization

Swaraj, a concept in Indian political thought, refers to both self-rule and rule over the self, emphasizing personal responsibility and self-realization.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Swaraj in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Liberalism: Focus on Individual
text:
Liberalism: Focus on Individual

Key terms: individual liberty, modern liberalism, individual choices

Modern liberalism prioritizes individual liberty and values individual choices, even when they disagree with others. It believes that entities like family and society have value only if they are valued by individuals.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Liberalism: Focus on Individual in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Mill's Harm Principle
text:
Mill's Harm Principle

Key terms: harm principle, John Stuart Mill, prevent harm to others

John Stuart Mill's harm principle states that the only purpose for which power can be rightfully exercised over any member of a civilized community, against their will, is to prevent harm to others.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Mill's Harm Principle in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Negative Liberty
text:
Negative Liberty

Key terms: negative liberty, inviolable area, external interference

Negative liberty seeks to define and defend an area in which the individual would be inviolable, where they can 'do, be or become' whatever they wish without external interference.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Negative Liberty in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Positive Liberty
text:
Positive Liberty

Key terms: positive liberty, individual development, self-expression

Positive liberty is concerned with improving conditions in society to enable the development of the individual personality, providing opportunities for self-expression and growth.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Positive Liberty in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Freedom of Expression
text:
Freedom of Expression

Key terms: freedom of expression, fundamental value, conflict of ideas

Freedom of expression is a fundamental value that should not be restricted, even for ideas that seem false or misleading, as truth emerges from the conflict of opposing views.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Freedom of Expression in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Justifiable Constraints
text:
Justifiable Constraints

Key terms: justifiable constraints, reasonable restrictions, prevent serious harm

Constraints on freedom should be justifiable, reasonable, and not excessive. They should only be imposed when necessary to prevent serious harm to others.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Justifiable Constraints in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Conflict of Ideas
text:
Conflict of Ideas

Key terms: ideas, truth, suppression

Different ideas challenge each other, helping us understand and trust the truth. Suppressing ideas may lead to losing valuable knowledge.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Conflict of Ideas in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Freedom as Choice and Responsibility
text:
Freedom as Choice and Responsibility

Key terms: freedom, choices, responsibility

Freedom is the ability to make choices and accept responsibility for the consequences. Education and parental care help develop this ability.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Freedom as Choice and Responsibility in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Negative vs Positive Liberty
text:
Negative vs Positive Liberty

Key terms: negative liberty, positive liberty

Negative liberty is the absence of constraints, while positive liberty is the ability to make choices and act on them.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Negative vs Positive Liberty in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Social Constraints and Freedom
text:
Social Constraints and Freedom

Key terms: constraints, freedom, order

Constraints can be necessary for enjoying freedom, as they help maintain order and protect individual liberties.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Social Constraints and Freedom in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Role of the State in Freedom
text:
Role of the State in Freedom

Key terms: state, freedom, citizens' rights

The state plays a crucial role in upholding citizens' freedoms by protecting their rights and providing necessary conditions for their exercise.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.topic: Role of the State in Freedom
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Role of the State in Freedom in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Freedom of Expression
text:
Freedom of Expression

Key terms: expression, restrictions, order

Freedom of expression allows individuals to share ideas and opinions, but reasonable restrictions may be necessary to protect others' rights and maintain order.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Freedom of Expression in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Equality as a Moral and Political Ideal
text:
Equality as a Moral and Political Ideal

Key terms: Equality, Moral Ideal, Political Ideal, Human Rights

Equality is a powerful concept that has guided societies for centuries. It's based on the idea that all humans have equal worth, regardless of their race, gender, or nationality. This notion is reflected in universal human rights.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.topic: Equality as a Moral and Political Ideal
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Equality as a Moral and Political Ideal in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Inequality vs. Equality in Society
text:
Inequality vs. Equality in Society

Key terms: Inequality, Equality, Wealth Disparity, Opportunity Gap

While everyone accepts the ideal of equality, inequality is prevalent in wealth, opportunities, and power. This paradox raises questions about the causes and consequences of inequality.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Inequality vs. Equality in Society in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Equality of Opportunities
text:
Equality of Opportunities

Key terms: Equality of Opportunities, Basic Goods, Education, Healthcare

Equality implies that everyone should have equal rights and opportunities to develop their skills and pursue their goals. This doesn't mean everyone will have the same status or wealth, but that everyone should have fair access to basic goods like education and healthcare.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Equality of Opportunities in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Natural vs. Social Inequalities
text:
Natural vs. Social Inequalities

Key terms: Natural Inequalities, Social Inequalities, Acceptable Inequalities, Unfair Inequalities

Natural inequalities are based on inherent differences, while social inequalities result from societal structures. The challenge is to distinguish between acceptable and unfair inequalities.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Natural vs. Social Inequalities in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Three Dimensions of Equality
text:
Three Dimensions of Equality

Key terms: Political Equality, Social Equality, Economic Equality

Equality can be pursued in three main dimensions: political (equal rights and opportunities), social (equal access to resources and services), and economic (equal distribution of wealth and work). Addressing these dimensions can lead to a more just society.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Three Dimensions of Equality in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Citizenship Rights
text:
Citizenship Rights

Key terms: citizenship, rights, voting, freedom

Citizenship brings basic rights like voting, freedom of expression, movement, association, and belief to participate in state affairs.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Citizenship Rights in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Legal Equality
text:
Legal Equality

Key terms: legal equality, law, participation, access

Legal equality ensures everyone is treated equally before the law, removing legal barriers to participation and access to social goods.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Legal Equality in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Equal Opportunities
text:
Equal Opportunities

Key terms: equal opportunities, social inequalities, economic inequalities, fair chance

Equal opportunities minimize social and economic inequalities to ensure everyone has a fair chance to compete for available goods and opportunities.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Equal Opportunities in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Social Inequalities
text:
Social Inequalities

Key terms: social inequalities, facilities, discriminatory customs, potential talent

Social inequalities, like lack of facilities or discriminatory customs, can hinder equal opportunities and waste potential talent.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Social Inequalities in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Economic Inequality
text:
Economic Inequality

Key terms: economic inequality, wealth, property, income

Economic inequality exists when there are significant differences in wealth, property, or income between individuals or classes.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Economic Inequality in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Entrenched Inequalities
text:
Entrenched Inequalities

Key terms: entrenched inequalities, class differences, resentment, violence

Entrenched inequalities, like class differences over generations, can lead to resentment and violence, making reform difficult.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Entrenched Inequalities in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Feminism
text:
Feminism

Key terms: feminism, patriarchy, equal rights, gender

Feminism advocates for equal rights for women and men, challenging patriarchal norms that justify unequal positions based on gender.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Feminism in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Affirmative Action
text:
Affirmative Action

Key terms: affirmative action, positive discrimination, historical inequalities, marginalized groups

Affirmative action, or positive discrimination, aims to address historical inequalities by providing advantages to marginalized groups.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Affirmative Action in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Special Considerations for Equality
text:
Special Considerations for Equality

Key terms: equality, affirmative action, disadvantaged groups

Sometimes, treating everyone equally may not be fair. Special provisions like ramps, protection for women, or affirmative action can enhance equality by leveling the playing field for disadvantaged groups.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Special Considerations for Equality in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Affirmative Action
text:
Affirmative Action

Key terms: affirmative action, reserved seats, disadvantaged groups

Affirmative action is a policy to correct past inequalities by providing special opportunities or preferences to disadvantaged groups, like reserved seats or scholarships.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Affirmative Action in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Criticism of Affirmative Action
text:
Criticism of Affirmative Action

Key terms: criticism, affirmative action, equality

Some argue that affirmative action is unfair as it treats people differently, reinforcing social divisions and going against the principle of treating everyone equally.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Criticism of Affirmative Action in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Equality vs Identical Treatment
text:
Equality vs Identical Treatment

Key terms: equality, identical treatment, differential treatment

Treating everyone equally doesn't always mean treating everyone in the same way. Sometimes, differential treatment is necessary to achieve genuine equality.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Equality vs Identical Treatment in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Women's Rights and Equality
text:
Women's Rights and Equality

Key terms: women's rights, equal rights, special considerations

Women's struggle for equal rights led to the realization that sometimes, special considerations are needed for them to enjoy the same rights as men, like maternity leave or crèches.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Women's Rights and Equality in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Intuitive Understanding of Justice
text:
Intuitive Understanding of Justice

Key terms: justice, intuitive understanding, social goods, duties

We have an intuitive understanding of justice, similar to love, but it's harder to define precisely. It's about how public life is ordered and how social goods and duties are distributed.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Intuitive Understanding of Justice in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Distributive Justice
text:
Distributive Justice

Key terms: distributive justice, social goods, duties, social justice

Distributive justice is about fairly distributing social goods and duties among members of society. It's a key aspect of social justice.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Distributive Justice in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | John Rawls' Theory of Justice
text:
John Rawls' Theory of Justice

Key terms: John Rawls, just society, rational grounds, just distribution

John Rawls argued that a just society would be in the interest of all members and could be defended on rational grounds. He proposed a theory of just distribution to achieve this.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to John Rawls' Theory of Justice in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Equal Treatment for Equals
text:
Equal Treatment for Equals

Key terms: equal treatment, equality, discrimination

This principle of justice states that all individuals should be treated equally and not discriminated against based on factors like caste, race, or gender.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Equal Treatment for Equals in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Proportionate Justice
text:
Proportionate Justice

Key terms: proportionate justice, reward, merit, equal treatment

Proportionate justice rewards people based on the scale and quality of their efforts. It balances the principle of equal treatment with the principle of rewarding merit.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Proportionate Justice in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Recognition of Special Needs
text:
Recognition of Special Needs

Key terms: special needs, disabilities, disadvantages, equality, justice

Society should recognize and address the special needs of people to ensure equality and justice. This could involve providing special help to those with disabilities or disadvantages.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Recognition of Special Needs in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Just Distribution of Resources
text:
Just Distribution of Resources

Key terms: just distribution, resources, equality, life conditions, opportunities

Social justice requires a just distribution of resources to provide a level playing field for citizens. This could involve redistributing resources to promote equality of life conditions and opportunities.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Just Distribution of Resources in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Rawls' Veil of Ignorance
text:
Rawls' Veil of Ignorance

Key terms: Veil of Ignorance, Justice, Fairness

John Rawls' theory of justice suggests imagining ourselves in a situation where we don't know our future social status to create fair rules for society.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Rawls' Veil of Ignorance in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Basic Minimum Conditions for Social Justice
text:
Basic Minimum Conditions for Social Justice

Key terms: Social Justice, Basic Needs, Equality of Opportunity

A just society should provide its citizens with basic needs like food, housing, education, and healthcare to ensure a healthy and secure life.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.topic: Basic Minimum Conditions for Social Justice
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Basic Minimum Conditions for Social Justice in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Free Markets vs. State Intervention
text:
Free Markets vs. State Intervention

Key terms: Free Markets, State Intervention, Social Justice

Debate on whether free markets or government intervention is the best way to achieve social justice and help the disadvantaged.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Free Markets vs. State Intervention in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Rational Action and Fairness
text:
Rational Action and Fairness

Key terms: Rational Action, Fairness, Justice

Rawls argues that rational thinking, not morality, can lead to fair and just decisions about distributing society's benefits and burdens.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Rational Action and Fairness in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Inequality and Social Justice
text:
Inequality and Social Justice

Key terms: Inequality, Social Justice, Equal Opportunities

Deep and persistent divisions between rich and poor can lead to a lack of social justice, which can be addressed through equal opportunities and basic minimum conditions.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Inequality and Social Justice in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Definition of Rights
text:
Definition of Rights

Key terms: rights, claims, entitlement

Rights are justified claims that we are entitled to as citizens, individuals, and human beings. They are necessary for leading a life of respect, dignity, and well-being.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Definition of Rights in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Universal Rights
text:
Universal Rights

Key terms: universal rights, livelihood, expression, education

Rights that are important for all human beings, such as the right to livelihood, freedom of expression, and education, are described as universal in nature.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Universal Rights in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Natural Rights
text:
Natural Rights

Key terms: natural rights, inalienable, life, liberty, property

The idea that rights are given to us by nature or God, and are inalienable. The three natural rights of man are life, liberty, and property.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Natural Rights in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Human Rights
text:
Human Rights

Key terms: human rights, equality, dignity, opportunities

Rights that all persons are entitled to simply because they are human beings. They are based on the idea that all persons are unique, equally valuable, and deserve equal opportunities.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Human Rights in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Legal Rights
text:
Legal Rights

Key terms: legal rights, constitution, obligations, state

Rights that are recognised and protected by law, often enshrined in constitutions. They place obligations on the state to act in certain ways and refrain from certain actions.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Legal Rights in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Political Rights
text:
Political Rights

Key terms: political rights, equality, participation, vote, parties

Rights that give citizens the right to equality before law and participate in the political process, such as the right to vote and form political parties.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Political Rights in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Civil Liberties
text:
Civil Liberties

Key terms: civil liberties, freedom, expression, protest, democracy

Rights that protect individual freedoms, such as the right to a fair trial, free expression, and protest. They are essential for a democratic system of government.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Civil Liberties in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Economic Rights
text:
Economic Rights

Key terms: economic rights, basic needs, work, political rights

Rights that ensure basic needs are met, such as the right to food, shelter, clothing, health, and reasonable conditions of work. They are necessary for exercising political rights fully.

metadata.subject: Political Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Economic Rights in Grade 11 Political Science.

title: NCERT Grade 11 Political Science | Economic Rights in Democracies
text:
Economic Rights in Democracies
